avis.titre: Plumps, hydrates and leaves you with beautiful glassy skin!
avis.texte: So I did not want to fall victim to fake TikTok Medicube hype, but I stared with the mild zero pore pads, then a peel off mask, now this and the collagen serum- all within 10 days cause now I GET IT! This makes my skin so plump, instant glass skin, lasting moisture, I just love it! The texture is super nice and it’s sooooo hydrating! Now it does smell like Grandma’s Perfume mixed with like herbal tea a little bit, but it’s not overpowering and it’s not a bad smell really. I just mostly use unscented products cause I have hella sensitive skin, but I’ve had no problems with this! I was using Byoma milky toner prior to this and this is soooo much more hydrating and plumping. It’s not too thin, it pats in well, and it leaves me with beautiful glassy skin! I will definitely keep buying this! This immediately helped with my texture and I’ve not broken out at all. Even if you have sensitive skin like I do- give it a try and enjoy the instant plumping!

I’ve tried countless Korean skincare toners, but the Medicube Triple Collagen Toner is in a league of its own. If you struggle with dull, dehydrated skin or just want that plump, bouncy look, this is a game-changer. ​What I Love: ​Deep Hydration: Unlike thin, watery toners, this has a slightly viscous, essence-like texture that feels incredibly luxurious. It sinks in almost immediately without leaving any sticky residue. ​The Plump Factor: With the triple collagen formula (hydrolyzed, atelo, and soluble), I noticed a visible difference in my skin’s elasticity within just a few days. My face looks "bouncy" and well-rested. ​Perfect for Layering: It works beautifully under makeup or heavier moisturizers. I personally love the "7-skin method" with this, but even one layer provides a massive moisture boost. ​Gentle on Skin: I have somewhat sensitive skin, and this has been very soothing with no irritation or breakouts. ​Final Verdict: ​It’s a bit of an investment compared to drugstore toners, but the 4.73 fl. oz. bottle lasts a long time since a little goes a long way. If you want that glowing, hydrated base every morning, buy it. Your skin will thank you!

avis.titre: A must-have in my skincare routine—keeps my skin clear and hydratedA must-have in my skincare routine—keeps my skin clea
avis.texte: I’ve been using this Toner for a while, and it has honestly become an essential part of my skincare routine. I’ve noticed a huge difference in my skin’s health since I started using it regularly. In fact, if I skip this toner for a few days, I start getting breakouts, which tells me just how effective it is for my skin. The hydration level is impressive. It feels very nourishing, and even though it is a toner, it provides a deep moisture boost that keeps my skin feeling plump and supple all day. The formula absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue, which is perfect for layering other serums or moisturizers on top. It gives my skin a healthy, transparent glow that I really love. If you are looking for a toner that provides both great hydration and helps maintain a clear complexion, I highly recommend giving this a try. It has been a total game-changer for my skin, and I definitely plan to keep this in my routine for the long run.

avis.titre: A Great Addition to My Anti-Aging Skincare Routine
avis.texte: The Medicube Triple Collagen Toner has quickly become one of my go-to skincare products. I've been using it along with other products from the same line, and the combination has been working wonderfully for my skin. At 45, I'm focused on improving the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles while maintaining healthy, glowing skin. So far, my skin feels smoother, more hydrated, and looks healthier. I'm excited to continue using it and plan to share before-and-after photos after 30 days to show my results!

Absolutely love this toner. It's got a great consistency that is not too watery, not too gel like-just right in the middle. The hydration and glow it gives are amazing, and it has become an absolute must have in my morning and night skin care routine. I feel like the overall texture of my skin has improved since using this product, which is most likely due to the microfine collagen that actually absorbs deep into the skin. Perfect for mature skin, but really of all ages. I highly recommend this toner-it has dramatically improved my skins appearance and texture.

avis.titre: Delightful moisturizing toner that layers well
avis.texte: So good. I have mature skin (54yrs with fine lines) and this toner is delightfully moisturizing without being overly sticky. It does well when layering products, too. I have several products from MediCube and whether using together or with other products, I do not find this to pill. Just a nice moisturized after glow. I will repurchase when I run out.

Love this toner! This collagen toner feels so nice...I find that it both tones and moisturizes. One night I was distracted and forgot to apply moisturizer after using the toner. In the morning my face still felt soft and supple without any stickiness whatsoever. The scent is clean and fresh, too. I have this toner in my Subscribe & Save!
I love this toner! It's super hydrating, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling soft, plump, and glowing. Definitely one of my favorite Medicube products.

avis.titre: Unique Toner Texture: Hydrating, Comfortable & Amazing for Morning Routine
avis.texte: I can confirm this Medicube Triple Collagen Toner is original. This toner is absolutely spectacular, and honestly I wish I had discovered it earlier. The texture is completely different from most toners I’ve tried. It is much thicker and more nourishing, almost like a lightweight essence rather than water. It adheres beautifully to the skin and leaves it feeling incredibly soft, hydrated, and comfortable. After using this toner, many other toners simply feel like water in comparison. It gives the skin a healthy, smooth, plump look and creates a great base for the rest of the skincare routine. The fragrance is very soft and pleasant, not overpowering at all. I especially love using it in the morning because it leaves my skin looking fresh, healthy, and glowing from the start of the day. Highly recommended if you enjoy deeply hydrating Korean skincare products with a more luxurious texture.
Muy buen producto. Absorbe y no deja graso. Ayuda mucho con la hidratación. No me sacó granos. Altamente recomendable.

I will mention that it can leave your hands feeling a bit sticky so be prepared to wash your hands after use. This is one of the first three products I’ve bought from the Medicube line and love it!

Very moisturizing and feels more like a serum than a toner but I use this after I use a Medicube Zero Pore Pad toner pad anyway. As for the results, I haven’t had it long enough to see but I’m expecting good things since I always have good results with Medicube products. My skin has never looked better!

Absolutely beautiful packaging, and works as well as any other toner but that’s about as much as I can say for it. Maybe I just don’t get the purpose of toners, but I didn’t notice anything about this that would make me say, “WOW.” It’s a basic toner. I was not particularly crazy about the smell. It was powdery, floral, and hung on for awhile after application. If you need a toner and you aren’t sensitive to the scents I mentioned, this one will work. I wouldn’t expect it to work any miracles.

avis.titre: Holy grail collagen routine — game changer for my skin!
avis.texte: I’ve been using Medicube’s Triple Collagen Toner once a week, usually on Sundays as part of my nighttime routine… and wow, it’s been a total game changer. After cleansing, I layer the toner first, followed by the Triple Collagen Serum, then the Collagen Jelly Cream, and finish with the Collagen Night Wrapping Mask. No exaggeration — this combo literally revives my skin back to its hydrated, plump, and radiant self! I’ve only been using these products for the past three weeks, but the results are already noticeable. My skin looks and feels healthier, and a little product goes a long way, so it’s definitely worth the investment. Highly recommend purchasing the toner along with the other collagen products I mentioned for best results. This routine has earned a permanent spot in my skincare lineup!

avis.texte: "At 51, finding skincare that actually delivers on its promises can be tough. This Medicube Triple Collagen Toner completely transformed my routine! It plumps, deeply hydrates, and gives my skin an instant, youthful bounce without feeling heavy or greasy. If you want a radiant, glass-skin glow that lasts all day, this bottle is absolute magic and the price couldn’t be better! Click my link to grab yours and see the difference!"

This toner looks, feels, and smells expensive and elegant. This has not become my go-to nightly routine along with another product. Why do I like this so much? Because it makes me want to continue using it. Let me explain. With any product, it'll require time and daily usage to see results. Some products are torture to apply due to texture, smell, not being practical etc. Those products would fail because they turn people off. This product however smells so good that I look forward to using it. Additionally, I feel that the liquid/collagen is being absorbed into my skin. I've used products where it feels superficial, like just a layer on skin. This toner doesn't feel like that. Everything points to me continuing to use this daily. I know with consistency results will come.

This is a thicker toner than I am accustomed to but it makes it easy to apply. Has a very faint, pleasant scent. It does feel a bit tacky after applying but this does dissipates after it is fully absorbed. It leaves my mature skin feeling more hydrated, moist and a bit plumper. One of the active active ingredients includes 1,2 Hexanediol that preserves hydration on the skin while also softening it. Overall I am very happy with how this makes my skin look and feel. Very Pretty (kind of rose gold) glass bottle. Reasonably priced.

This is a nice, thick toner full of niacinamide, HA, and collagen. I use my hands to apply it. It absorbs nicely and leave my skin feeling plump and hydrated. After using it for two weeks along with the matching deep cream, my skin is baby smooth, clear, and bright. It does have a floral fragrance. My sensitive skin tolerated it fine, but if you are sensitive to scents, this might not be for you.
